notes.title: Our teaser devlog is out
notes.content:
Hey! 
🌟 Great news – our first devlog is live! Go check it out:

[previewyoutube=LF8qJhce5E0;full][/previewyoutube] 

Dive into the details of our upcoming game, a unique twist on a beloved game. Imagine playing as the behind-the-scenes hero, maintaining the battleground during matches. Learn how I ended up starting working on the game and what inspired me. It's not your typical FPS it is a full-fledged Clean-em-up massacre! Check out the devlog now for all the details.
